entities.summary: Jermaine Dontay Thomas is an American professional basketball player for Cuore Napoli Basket. He played basketball for Governor Thomas Johnson High School in Frederick, Maryland and La Salle University in Philadelphia. Thomas has played in several countries, including for Spanish team Bàsquet Manresa in Liga ACB. In 2019, Thomas was charged and sentenced to 3 years in jail with sex abuse at the Jefferson School in Frederick, Maryland
